concept.concept: Dark-background design with a crescent moon and bold text 'I Work While You Sleep — Don't Talk to Me Before Noon' in block typography.
concept.audience: Night shift nurses, factory workers, and service industry employees
concept.rationale: Night shift worker identity is an underserved niche with a tight-knit community. Strong gifting angle from coworkers. Evergreen with no seasonal dependency, and the humor resonates deeply with a loyal, vocal audience.

design.image_prompt:
The design prominently features the text "I WORK WHILE YOU SLEEP
DON'T TALK TO ME BEFORE NOON" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a crescent moon in pale cream, tilted slightly to the right, centered on a solid charcoal background. Bold geometric block sans-serif text reading 'I WORK WHILE YOU SLEEP' arched in a subtle curve above the moon, and 'DON'T TALK TO ME BEFORE NOON' in matching block letters below, all in white. Three solid color blocks only: charcoal background, cream moon, white text. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition with clean sharp edges and generous margins. High contrast, screen-print aesthetic, readable from 12 feet away.

design.style: Flat vector illustration, bold geometric block typography, screen-print aesthetic, solid color blocks only, no gradients or shading

verdict.reason: The phrase 'I Work While You Sleep — Don't Talk to Me Before Noon' is a generic humorous sentiment commonly found in novelty merchandise. It references no trademarks, brand names, celebrities, characters, or protected slogans. The crescent moon graphic is a generic design element. The block typography style is standard. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: All required text is present and correctly spelled: 'I WORK WHILE YOU SLEEP' arched around a crescent moon graphic, and 'DON'T TALK TO ME BEFORE NOON' below. Clean vector-style design with no IP concerns, no quality issues, and no extraneous elements. Black background is suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: I Work While You Sleep Night Shift Worker T-Shirt
listing.description: Perfect tee for those who own the night shift. Features bold block typography stating 'I Work While You Sleep — Don't Talk to Me Before Noon' with crescent moon accents on a dark background. Ideal for night shift nurses, factory workers, and service industry employees who live by a different schedule. Comfortable, durable fabric designed for comfort during long shifts. Great gift for healthcare workers, overnight staff, and anyone working unconventional hours who appreciates honest, relatable humor.
